title: Source geometric comparison equivalence
statement:
Under the derived localization instances and geometric hypotheses in the following signature, the explicit residue cycle quotient has an additive equivalence to degree-one structure-sheaf fibre cohomology: theorem picard_residue_homology_geometric_comparison_source
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{v},
      HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Y : Scheme.{v}) (U : Y.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1}
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S) [IsImmersion k]
    (w : W) (s : S) (hw : k w = s)
    (τ : (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))).obj L ≅
      SheafOfModules.unit (pullback f (S.fromSpecResidueField s)).ringCatSheaf)
    (U : W.Opens) (hwU : w ∈ U) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (p : Ideal Γ(W, U)) [p.IsPrime]
    (hp : p = RingHom.ker (W.evaluation U w hwU).hom)
    (K : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hK : IsStrictlyPerfect W U K)
    (hE : Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v}
      (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
      ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L))) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj K))
    :
    Nonempty (affineResidueCycleHomology W U p K ≃+
        Sheaf.H (structureSheafAb (pullback f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))) 1)

source.place: Tags 0B91, 0BF2, 01XK; parent steps 1, 2 and 4 on homology rather than cycles

proof.text: Define E to be the displayed derived direct image. Apply the generic affine residue comparison to W,E,w,U,p,K using hK and hE. Independently apply the geometric fibre comparison using f,L,k,hw,tau. Both intermediate additive equivalences have derivedFiberCohomology W E 1 w as the middle group. Eliminate their Nonempty propositions inside the proof and compose by AddEquiv.trans. No data definition chooses an arbitrary equivalence.
